basic_info.description: Welcome to 2640 Alemany Boulevard, a spacious and light-filled 4-bedroom, 2-bath home offering comfort and flexibility across multiple levels. The main upper level features an open living and dining area, a well-appointed kitchen with stainless steel appliances, two bright bedrooms, and a full bath. Skylights and large windows flood the space with natural light, creating a warm and inviting ambiance. On the ground level, you'll find a versatile bonus space with a full bath and kitchenette, perfect for a home office, creative studio, or additional living area. The lower level includes two more bedrooms, providing privacy and separation ideal for multi-generational living or guests. A private fenced yard, two-car garage, and driveway parking complete the home. Conveniently located near public transit, shopping, dining, and major freeways, 2640 Alemany offers a practical and stylish lifestyle in a prime San Francisco location. A must-see for those seeking space and flexibility.
